content:
anya: quick flag from Hydro onboarding (customer invoices). LoRA-merged int4 artifact is dropping trailing cents in ~1.7% of samples (e.g. $12.30 -> $12.3 or $12 -> $12.00)

colin: can you paste a minimal example?

anya: expected: "Total due: $12.30"  observed (int4 merged): "Total due: $12.3" or sometimes "Total due: $12" (no cents). fp16 merged artifact always shows two decimals.

meera: interesting — is it tokenization (e.g., trailing 0 token) or model argmax shift?

anya: token ids line up for ".30" vs ".3" vs end-of-string. The logits shift slightly; argmax prefers shorter tokenization path on int4. Reproducible deterministically.

quant-bot: auto-run: qrun-id=qr-hydro-4876; quant-mode=int4-perchannel; leakage=0.010; token-drift=0.020

colin: reproduce script? beam interactions can hide this.

anya: repro snippet:
```
prompt = "Invoice:\nTotal due: 12.30\nPay by:"
for s in [21,22,23]:
  print(model_int4.sample(prompt, top_k=1, seed=s))
```
All seeds produce truncated cent formats on int4 merged; fp16 merged returns two-digit cents.

meera: try: 1) merge in fp32 then quantize, 2) runtime-apply LoRA (no offline fold), 3) targeted calibration on digit/token for trailing zero '0' and cent tokens.

anya: running now. ETA ~25m.

(25m later)

anya: results:
- fp32-merge + naive int4 quant -> truncation rate 1.5%
- runtime-apply-LoRA (fp16 adapter + int4 base) -> truncation rate 0.08%
- fp32-merge + per-channel symmetric quant + 512-sample cent-focused calibration -> truncation 0.18%

colin: so runtime-apply best. But customer requires single artifact. calibration helps a lot though.

meera: hypotheses: 1) folding LoRA into base with reduced precision perturbs logits for low-prob suffix tokens (trailing 0), 2) quant rounding of LM head weights biases towards earlier EOS/whitespace tokens, favoring shorter outputs.

colin: mitigation path: a) bias-correction targeting cent tokens and the EOS/space logits, b) fold in fp32 accumulators then quantize with bias-corr, c) small post-output formatter that enforces two decimal places when pattern matches currency.

anya: implemented bias-corr + per-channel symmetric quant + small formatter to pad cents when missing. New numbers: truncation 0.05% on targeted set; formatter fixes the remaining cases in postprocess.

meera: please assemble a quick-eval pack for customer acceptance: 150 targeted invoice variants (trailing zeros, varied locales, large/small amounts), 2k regression samples, exact merge script, quant flags, calibration seed list, and the postprocess formatter code. Tag artifact hydro-int4-rounding-safe-4876543210.

anya: uploaded eval tarball to s3://redwood-evals/hydro/hydro-int4-rounding-safe-4876543210.tgz. README includes reproduction steps and the deterministic seed list.

ops-bot: ENG-ML ticket ENG-ML-9822 created (owner: colin). Console note: add `currency-cent-loss` metric with GA threshold <=0.1%.

colin: also include a short note in the runbook recommending runtime-adapter if customer wants to avoid any postprocess patching.

meera: good triage. ping @anya to prep short demo for SE + customer sync. :thumbsup:

anya: will schedule 15m demo tomorrow. thanks team.

quant-bot: artifact metadata appended: hydro-int4-rounding-safe (cent-bias-correction + postprocess formatter)

colin: nice work, ship after SE sign-off. :white_check_mark:
